title: Taiwan semiconductor investment, compliance, talent, and delivery
discussion_signal: The post describes Taiwanese outbound investment and U.S. fab expansion as a capacity promise that depends on compliance, talent, permitting, suppliers, and technology-transfer coordination. It adds a delivery-infrastructure lens: announced allied investment is not the same as realized resilient capacity.
linked_research_question: How do allied semiconductor investment commitments become domestic capacity, and which regulatory, workforce, and delivery constraints determine whether they materialize?
limits: The post is an industry observation rather than an official investment ledger
Investment commitments do not prove completed capacity
Some figures and claims require independent source verification
